es: Resolver un caso nuevo de entrada B2 contando un cambio, formulando una hipótesis o un deseo, reportando lo dicho por dos personas, argumentando con cautela y registrando una revisión.

teaching.en: The youth club used to open on Saturdays, but since January it has been opening only on weekdays.
teaching.es: El club juvenil solía abrir los sábados, pero desde enero abre solo entre semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Used to + base cuenta el hábito pasado; since January + has been opening cuenta el cambio hasta hoy.

teaching.explanationEs: Dos reportes: told us that / said that + had + participio, porque lo dicho era anterior.

prompt.es: ¿Qué oración cuenta ese cambio con los tiempos adecuados?

choices.text: The club used to opening on Saturdays, but since January it opens on weekdays.
The club used to open on Saturdays, but since January it has been opening on weekdays.
The club is used to open on Saturdays, but since January it was opening on weekdays.

feedback.es: El hábito pasado lleva used to + verbo base, y el cambio desde enero hasta hoy lleva has been + -ing. Las otras versiones mezclan formas.

hint.es: Hábito pasado: used to + verbo base. Desde enero hasta hoy: has been + -ing.

prompt.es: Resuelve el caso nuevo en 130–170 palabras y cierra con una nota de revisión.

answer.text: The school bus used to stop in front of our school, but since September it has been stopping only at the station. The driver told us that the town had changed the route, and Tom said that many students had been arriving late. If the town had asked the students earlier, the bus would still stop at the school now, and I wish it had done that. In my view, this is arguably a mistake, because tired students learn less. Admittedly, the town has a small budget. However, I think the director could help, and a short talk with her would give students a safe way to school again. My plan is to speak with the director by Friday, and I am sure she would listen. Final revision: I changed soon to by Friday, so the deadline is clear.
accepted: The school bus used to stop in front of our school, but since September it has been stopping only at the station. The driver told us that the town had changed the route, and Tom said that many students had been arriving late. If the town had asked the students earlier, the bus would still stop at the school now, and I wish it had done that. In my view, this is arguably a mistake, because tired students learn less. Admittedly, the town has a small budget. However, I think the director could help, and a short talk with her would give students a safe way to school again. My plan is to speak with the director by Friday, and I am sure she would listen. Final revision: I changed soon to by Friday, so the deadline is clear.

Since September, the school bus has been stopping only at the station, although it used to stop in front of our school. The driver said that the town had changed the route, and Tom told us that many students had been arriving late. If the town had asked the students earlier, the bus would still stop at the school today. I wish it had asked them. It is arguably a mistake, because tired students learn less. It is true that the town has a small budget, but I think the director could help. I suggest speaking with the director by Friday, because a short talk with her would give students a safe way to school again. Final revision: I replaced soon with by Friday, so the deadline is clear.

feedback.es: La respuesta cuenta el cambio, reporta a dos personas, imagina otra situación, argumenta con cautela y registra una revisión con qué cambió y por qué.

origin.text: Caso nuevo: el autobús escolar de tu barrio. Antes paraba delante del colegio; desde septiembre solo para en la estación. La conductora dijo que la ciudad había cambiado la ruta, y Tom dijo que muchos alumnos llegaban tarde. Si la ciudad hubiera preguntado antes a los alumnos, hoy el autobús seguiría parando en el colegio, y ojalá lo hubiera hecho. Tu postura: es un error (dilo con cautela), aunque reconoces que el presupuesto de la ciudad es pequeño. Propuesta: hablar con la directora antes del viernes. Termina con una nota de revisión: un cambio que mejora tu texto.
